protocol.issue_frequency: fresh day-ahead features daily, coefficients refit weekly; not a seven-day forecast issued at refit
protocol.normalization_imputation_pca_fit: eligible training rows only at every refit
protocol.late_test_adaptation: earlier test labels become training data under the fixed D-2 protocol; no hyperparameter reselection
protocol.features: D-2 same civil-hour four-country residuals, causal country and country-hour EWMA residuals
protocol.dst: both physical target hours retained; repeated civil-hour lag residuals averaged; missing lag feature imputed using training data only
protocol.corrections: point median only, no corrected quantiles or uncertainty claims
protocol.delta_sign: competitor loss minus NYX loss; negative favors competitor
protocol.bootstrap_limits: conditional on these 90 summer-dominated days and selected hyperparameters; neither vintage uncertainty nor selection uncertainty included

limitations: No prospective gain claimed: retrospective frozen prequential forecasts are not actually issued vintages.
Actual and frozen labels can be revised after historical origins; D-2 alone cannot prove availability.
Final 90-day holdout covers June-September rather than the entire seasonal cycle.
Secondary family/country/regime contrasts are descriptive; no multiplicity adjustment.
Storm official benchmark availability at strict 08:00 cutoff has not been established.
No Tensor-TimesFM forecasts or training were run; no complementarity claim against that model.
